verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes official client libraries under its GitHub org. The Python package shows a working usage example and covers multiple engines, and it points users to a newer official serpapi-python successor. The integrations docs say to "install the library for your language," which suggests SDKs in several languages. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of SDKs beyond Python, documentation of the newer serpapi-python library itself (the evidenced package is slated for deprecation), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
